nurse.text: Mind the penguin on the step. This is the sick bay. It's four beds, a heater and a kettle, and nobody has ever needed more than the kettle.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit. Hands round the mug. Your team will be warm in a minute, and a penguin is looking at you through the window, so that's a bonus.
All done. Right as rain, which for here is a very big claim, being snow.
The Ark's through there, behind the boxes of stamps.

else.text: No trouble. Pop in any time you're cold, which is always.
